whatIs: Tabler Icons is a set of more than 6,000 SVG icons on a 24x24 grid with a 2 px stroke, in outline and filled styles. You can use them as loose SVGs, a webfont, a sprite, PNG, PDF or EPS, or through npm packages for React, React Native, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular, Astro and others.
It's a good fit when you want a large, uniform-style set that you can use as components in your framework and whose color and stroke width you can adjust.
uses: Use icons as React or Vue components with @tabler/icons-react or its equivalent, changing size and color through props.
Give an admin dashboard with hundreds of different screens consistent iconography.
Export individual icons as SVG or PNG for a Figma design or a presentation.
caveats: The set is MIT licensed, so it works in personal and commercial projects; if you redistribute the files, keep the license notice.
The webfont loads every icon; in React, Vue and other frameworks, import each icon by name so the bundler drops the rest.
The same page sells a $9 Bundle with the icons precompiled as PNG, PDF and webfont; it's optional, because those formats can also be installed for free from npm.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; the $9 Bundle and the $69 package with other Tabler products are optional.
idealFor: Web projects that need many consistent icons as components.
